1170-1645-2397-5954-8345.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1074-4613-4644.easyPrerequisites:
King Macar doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1074-4613-4644.description:
Activate King Macar using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it, untapping King Macar
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do.
Repeat.

2577-4826-7084-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-4826-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2113-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
2113-4687-5296.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

2511-3756-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

1594-2034-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Helm of Awakening.
Repeat.

1061-3934-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-3934-5778.description:
Cast TImestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Determined Iteration triggers, creating a copy of the Timestream Navigator token with haste.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token from step 5 by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat steps 5 and 7 during each following turn.

2043-4659-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three multicolored permanents.
2043-4659-6741.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three Robots, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1322-2713-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1322-2713-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

4217-6747-7101.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4217-6747-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 3.

1563-2457-3000-4460.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1251-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
1251-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
1251-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

321-399-2475-2604-6707.description:

When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

391-3525-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat.

4508-5880-6291-7040.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-4772-5220-5632-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4772-5220-5632-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating two creature tokens and two Clue tokens
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2034-2350-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6054-6798-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1690-2146-2538-5034.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Cloud Key.
1690-2146-2538-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2146-2538-5034.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

2316-3129-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-3129-4871.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Hogaak, adding {R}.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Triclopean Sight from exile by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Sanctum Weaver.
Triclopean Sight enters the battlefield, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

Whirler Rogue enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Thopters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.

2097-2816-3809-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2097-2816-3809-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Black Market Tycoon by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

Dalakos does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dalakos.

Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Dalakos triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

1202-2034-3249.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Myr Moonvessel.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each player with an even life total and nearly lethal damage to each player with an odd life total.
You cannot lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
